source.title: Going Between Terminals | Access | Haneda Airport Passenger Terminal

facts.evidence: Each route: 'First departure at ... last departure at ...'
facts.notes: These are INTER-TERMINAL shuttles, not services to the city. Last departures are after midnight (next calendar day). The page states intervals of 4 minutes from 5:00am to 8:00pm and 8 minutes from 8:00pm to 12:00am; frequencyMinutes is omitted because it varies and no interval is stated for 00:00 to the last departure. No journey times stated. No city-bound rail first/last trains were sourced.
